messages:
incident-bot: Pager: cont-batch pool cb-prod crossing 99th latency SLO for /v1/generate (alerts: 3/5 windows). severity: high :rotating_light:
priya (oncall): grabbing it, hopping into metrics and logs now. any immediate customer pages?
alex: support says two enterprise tenants reported 5xx/timeout spikes ~10:02 UTC. no error traces yet.
priya (oncall): noted. starting with recent deploys + batch config changes. who touched continuous-batching last 24h?
maya: I did a quick rollout of adaptive-prefetch yesterday to reduce cold tokens, but no cb config edits. Alex rolled perf cliff knob for microbatch sizing earlier today (03:10).
priya (oncall): ok pulling audit: `kubectl get deploy cb-controller -o yaml | sed -n '1,120p'`
ops-bot: cb-controller image: rwinf/cb-controller:2026.2.1, args: --microbatch-max=64 --adaptive-threshold=0.72 --jitter=0.12
alex: I did bump `--microbatch-max` to 64 to improve throughput for a heavy seq model. rollback if needed.
priya (oncall): telemetry shows sudden kv cache growth and eviction thrash on mmu-8 nodes coincident with microbatch max bump. KV miss rate spiked from 6% -> 38% at 10:01 UTC.
ryan: that explains queueing. continuous batching relies on stable KV hit -> big microbatches amplify cache pressure -> eviction cascade.
priya (oncall): mitigation plan: (1) reduce `--microbatch-max` to 32, (2) throttle incoming concurrency at ingress for cb-prod, (3) trigger targeted KV cache soft-flush for affected shard set. doing 1 now.
priya (oncall): running: `kubectl set env deploy/cb-controller MICROBATCH_MAX=32 --namespace inference-prod`
ops-bot: env updated, rolling restart started for cb-controller (3/3 pods).
priya (oncall): step 2: applying rate-limit gate on route `/v1/generate` for cb-prod to reduce burst. `redwoodctl rate-limit set --route /v1/generate --concurrency 220 --scope cb-prod`
ops-bot: rate-limit applied. connections throttled at edge.
maya: I'm prepping a KV soft-flush: iterate affected KV shards and drop only ephemeral prefixes to avoid cold starts. command: `rwinf-kvctl flush --shards=4,5,6 --prefix=ephemeral/--soft`
priya (oncall): hold on, first check impact of soft-flush on p99 latency — we want to avoid massive cold start. run it on one shard as canary.
maya: running canary flush on shard 4 now.
maya: canary results: eviction dropped memory by 18%, tail latency improved by 22% on that pod, request success rate steady. good to proceed.
priya (oncall): rolling soft-flush on shards 4-6 now.
ryan: monitoring dashboards: p99 dropping back toward SLOs, KV miss rate trending down. throughput still below normal but stable.
priya (oncall): initiating a partial rollback of microbatch-max bump to previous stable (32 -> 24) for canary groups; scheduling gradual rollback across all zones.
priya (oncall): patch for cb-controller prepared: reduce `--microbatch-max` to `24`, increase `--jitter` to `0.18`, add dynamic kv-throttle toggle.
priya (oncall): applying hotfix config to canary zone: `kubectl patch deploy cb-controller -p '{"spec":{"template":{"spec":{"containers":[{"name":"cb-controller","env":[{"name":"MICROBATCH_MAX","value":"24"},{"name":"JITTER","value":"0.18"}]}}]}}}' --namespace=inference-prod --context=zone-a`
ops-bot: hotfix applied to zone-a canary. pod restarts: 1/1 succeeded.
priya (oncall): metrics look good for canary: p99 within SLO, KV eviction stabilized. promoting hotfix to other zones in 5m.
ryan: customer-impact update: 3 tenants saw degraded requests during spike window (10:00-10:12 UTC). support will send preliminary notification.
priya (oncall): opening incident doc: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-2482 (live notes linked). adding action items: post-mortem, automated knob guardrail, kv soft-flush runbook, adaptive microbatch safety limits.
maya: created PR for cb-controller to add a safety limit flag `--max-allowed-microbatch=48` enforced by operator.
priya (oncall): agreed. long-term: add automated canary ramps and KV pressure detection to prevent full rollout on config bumps.
priya (oncall): handing off to ryan for 10:30->18:00 follow-up. I'm logging out of pager. :wave:
ryan: taking over. will continue monitoring, schedule postmortem invite for 1400 UTC, and coordinate customer comms.
sre-pager: Pager closed by priya (oncall) at 10:22 UTC. :white_check_mark:
priya (oncall): thanks team. leaving notes in INC-2482 — please add any logs or traces you collected. :memo:
